d: The Engineer – Operational Excellence will spearhead site‑wide initiatives that enhance safety, quality, productivity, cost efficiency, delivery performance, and customer satisfaction. Reporting to the QA department (FG 3069‑040‑00515 QA – General – 4300), you will supervise the QC team, ensure rigorous inspection and testing, maintain product traceability, manage non‑conformance controls, uphold the Quality Management System, support internal and external audits, and lead root‑cause analyses with corrective actions and data‑driven performance reviews.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Industrial, or related field).
Minimum 4 years of experience in manufacturing or quality engineering roles.
Proven experience leading operational excellence or continuous improvement programs.
Strong knowledge of Lean manufacturing tools and methodologies.
Hands‑on experience with inspection techniques, quality systems, and product traceability.
Demonstrated ability to conduct root‑cause analysis and implement corrective actions.
Familiarity with ISO 9001 or equivalent quality management standards.
Excellent analytical, problem‑solving, and data‑driven decision‑making skills.
Effective communication and leadership abilities to supervise cross‑functional teams.
Proficiency with quality and data analysis software (e.g., Minitab, SPC tools).
r: li
Develop and execute operational excellence and continuous improvement strategies across the site.
li
Supervise the Quality Control team to ensure inspections, testing, and product traceability meet customer and regulatory standards.
li
Maintain and improve the Quality Management System (QMS) and support internal and external audits.
li
Lead root‑cause investigations, corrective action plans, and preventive measures.
li
Analyze performance data to identify trends, drive improvements, and report results to senior management.
li
Implement Lean tools (5S, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping) to reduce waste and increase efficiency.
li
Collaborate with production, engineering, and supply‑chain teams to align quality objectives with operational goals.
li
Monitor safety, quality, productivity, cost, and delivery metrics, ensuring targets are met or exceeded.
li
Facilitate training and coaching on quality and Lean methodologies for staff at all levels.
li
Ensure compliance with all applicable standards, specifications, and customer requirements.

d: The Senior Offshore Structural Engineer is responsible for leading the design, analysis, and integrity assessment of offshore structures

including jackets, topsides, subsea structures, and floating systems. The role involves ensuring compliance with Saudi Aramco Standards, international codes, supervising junior engineers, and supporting engineering activities through all project phases including FEED, detailed design, installation, and decommissioning.
Lead structural design and advanced engineering analysis for offshore platforms and subsea systems.
Perform global and local analyses including in-place, loadout, lifting, fatigue, strength, buckling, and earthquake analysis.
Review and approve structural calculations, drawings, and project documentation.
Ensure engineering deliverables meet technical requirements, manhour budgets, and schedules.
Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams including piping, instrumentation, mechanical, electrical, architectural, pipelines, and geotechnical engineers.
Provide technical support during fabrication, installation, and offshore construction activities.
Develop and implement structural integrity management strategies for brownfield assets.
Review Saudi Aramco standards and design codes (API RP 2A/2SIM, ISO 19900 series, DNV-GL standards) and ensure compliance.
Mentor junior engineers and review their work.
Perform single disciple checks on drawings and documents.
Perform inter disciple checks on drawings and documents.
q: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in civil/Structural Engineering.
10+ years of offshore structural engineering experience.
Strong knowledge of Saudi Aramco standards and offshore structural design codes (API, DNV, ISO).
Proficiency in structural analysis tools (SACS and Staad.Pro).
Experience in FEED, detailed engineering, and brownfield modifications.
Understanding of offshore construction and installation methods.
Strong communication, leadership, and technical report-writing skills.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple assignments.

d: Almarai is the world’s largest vertically integrated dairy and the region’s largest food and beverage manufacturing and distribution company. Almarai currently employs over 46,000 employees servicing some 110,000 retail outlets and has reported net income of SAR 2.04 billion on sales of SAR 19.57 billion in 2023. For more details, please visit our website – www.almarai.com.

An aggressive expansion program together with acquisitions in new vertical markets have created an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic multinational team dedicated to furthering growth plans for the group.

To support the Divisional Training Department to ensure achievement of regional learning goals by constantly equipping the employees with the skills, knowledge and right attitude through Classroom & On-the-job training to enhance the operational efficiency and performance of individuals and teams.
q: Bachelor’s degree in business or literature.
3 years training /supervising experience in FMCG environment.
Fluency in writing and speaking English & Arabic.
Knowledge of Training Needs Analysis process.

Competencies such as; Able to develop/designing training packages. Able to develop a strong degree of respect, loyalty, trustworthiness, to create and maintain a motivated, healthy working environment. d: We're Hiring: Professional Educator – Skin / Skin Therapist
Are you passionate about skincare, skin treatments, and beauty education? MADI International is looking for aProfessional Educator – Skin / Skin Therapistto join our team in Oman.

We are seeking an enthusiastic skincare professional who can deliver engaging training, share technical expertise, and empower beauty professionals with the knowledge and skills needed to achieve outstanding results. If you combine hands-on skincare experience with a passion for education and product knowledge, we'd love to hear from you!
Conduct professional training sessions, workshops, and demonstrations on skincare products, treatments, protocols, and application techniques.
Educate beauty professionals, salon and spa teams, and customers on skincare routines, ingredients, product benefits, and treatment recommendations.
Demonstrate professional skin treatments and application techniques in accordance with product guidelines and safety standards.
Provide skincare consultations and skin analysis, recommending suitable products and treatments based on individual skin needs.
Develop and deliver training materials, presentations, and educational resources tailored to different audiences.
Support the sales team through product education, technical guidance, and training initiatives that drive product knowledge and sales performance.
Stay updated on skincare trends, innovations, treatment techniques, and industry best practices.
Evaluate training effectiveness, gather feedback, and continuously enhance educational programs.
Build strong relationships with clients and beauty professionals while representing MADI International and its partner brands professionally.
q: Proven experience as a Skin Therapist, Skincare Specialist, Esthetician, or in a similar professional skincare role.
Strong practical knowledge of skincare products, skin types, skin concerns, facial treatments, and professional application techniques.
Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to deliver engaging training sessions and explain technical skincare concepts clearly.
Energetic, professional, and passionate about skincare, beauty, and education.
Willingness to travel locally for training sessions and client visits, as required.
Flexibility to work according to training schedules and business requirements.
Certification or diploma in skincare, aesthetics, beauty therapy, cosmetology, or a related field.
Previous experience as a Professional Educator, Beauty Trainer, or Skincare Trainer.
Experience working with professional skincare brands, salons, spas, or aesthetic clinics.
Familiarity with training presentations, digital learning tools, and educational content development.
Knowledge of skincare brands and professional beauty industry trends in Oman and the wider GCC.
